text: Recommendations for head office specifications will be provided; the team will also compute the average rating for the evaluation criteria.

Problems identified include unclear pricing currency (Euros or Dollars), uncertain profitability due to unaccounted overheads beyond 50 percent, potential omission of overhead costs (salaries and heating), and unknown costs for voice recognition integration.

Decisions were made to use a kinetic charger, place kinetic batteries in the top section near the hinge, implement a push-button interface, and proceed to produce a prototype and bring it to market based on evaluation results.
There are proposals to remove voice recognition and to adjust pricing to fit.
